1.The present anticipatory bail application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking
anticipatory bail in case crime No.80 of 2024 under sections 498A, 304B I.P.C., read with sections
3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Mahesganj, district Pratapgarh.
2.Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned Additional Government Advocate for the State who has opposed the prayer made by applicant's counsel..
Notice to respondent No.2 is dispensed with in view of the proposed order.
3.The applicant is an accused in a case under sections 304-B and 498A I.P.C.
It is a case of dowry death.
The deceased died within seven years of her marriage in unnatural circumstance.
